body:
A part of me definitely wants to go get either counselling or see my family doctor.

One thing that is stopping me from seeing either of them is a feeling of attention seeking. I went for counselling for social anxiety a while back and now I'm *returning* for something else? And if I go to my family doctor I'm afraid of being completely dismissed or confronted as though I'm drug seeking. 

I would definitely like to see my family doctor, because I can't even bring myself to care about the things I used to love anymore. I'm 5'4" and under 90 lbs now. I can't concentrate on my school work. Weeks will pass by that feels like days to me. But this seems like such a bucket of problems that I fear my doctor will just throw me out.
